findings.title: D-R20-05 removed the unconnected inner rings of two 1.3 mm terminal PTHs, leaving their hole walls 0.25 mm from foreign inner-plane copper; JLC's published minimum for inner-layer PTH hole to copper is 0.30 mm, and no DRC rule checks it

references: J1.2 (GND), hole 1.3 mm at (7.4, 77.6): In2 RAW_PROTECTED fill 0.250 mm from the drawn hole wall; no In2 flash (Gerber In2_Cu has no D03 at X7.4 Y-77.6)
J400.2 (BAT_SW_RETURN, U9 EN), hole 1.3 mm at (7.4, 67.6): In1 GND fill 0.250 mm from the drawn hole wall; no In1 / In2 flash
evidence.measured: Every plated hole against every foreign-net inner copper edge (zone fills, tracks, pads, via flashes; pcbnew polygons, NumPy segment distance; probe hole_cu.py / hole_cu.txt): 62 PTH pad holes, 2 below 0.30 mm (the two above, 0.250 mm each); the next smallest PTH is J3's shell slots at 0.45 mm and every other DB125 hole is >= 0.55 mm. All 604 via-hole/inner-layer pairs are >= 0.25 mm against JLC's 0.20 mm via rule (pass). Before D-R20-05 both holes were 0.551 mm from that copper (their rings were the nearer copper). The only hole-clearance rule is m3.kicad_dru 'General copper to hole clearance' min 0.25 mm, applied to vias and PTH pads alike, so DRC (0 violations) passes them.
evidence.maker: JLCPCB PCB capabilities, https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (fetched 2026-10-31): 'Inner layer PTH pad hole to copper clearance 0.3mm'; 'Inner layer via hole to copper clearance 0.2mm'; 'Hole size Tolerance, Through-holes: +0.13 / -0.08 mm'
evidence.records: docs/M3_R10.md line 42 and R10_VALIDATION row 9 / line 1926 record the J1.2 0.25 mm as 'the hole clearance of every GND via in a RAW region', i.e. they apply the via figure to a 1.3 mm component hole; the J400.2 In1 0.250 mm is recorded as S-8-exempt (safe direction) but not against the fabricator rule.

findings.impact: A DFM shortfall, not a hazard. A 1.3 mm plated component hole is drilled oversize and its finished size may be up to +0.13 mm, so the drilled wall can come to about 0.18 mm or closer from the plane with registration. If JLC's DFM flags it, the order is held. If it is built as drawn, a smear or wicking short would tie GND to RAW_PROTECTED (U9 current-limits it, so the board cannot power up) or tie U9 EN to GND (the board stays off, which fails safe). Either short shows up at JLC's bare-board E-test as a scrapped board, not as a field fault.
findings.concrete_fix: Add a PTH-specific rule to the generated DRU (r10_sch.py writes m3.kicad_dru): (rule "PTH hole to inner copper (JLC 0.30 mm)" (layer inner) (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole'") (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.35mm))). Then refill. The In2 RAW_PROTECTED pour pulls back to 0.35 mm at J1.2 and the In1 GND pour does the same at J400.2; S-8 is unaffected because it only grows. Re-run K-plane / K-region / DRC. The alternative is to restore J1.2's In2 ring with a distinct GND-pad footprint, which still leaves J400.2. Until it is fixed, record it as a deviation and ask JLC to accept 0.25 mm in writing.
